items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: Who would he have in his man? George McCullough, of course, and myself.

ctx.x: No, he's dead now. He's dead now. But he's from Omaha.

Oh yeah. I know he'd come down here sometime. Yeah. I don't want to see his name in advertisements, you know. Yeah. In the old newspapers all I can know. Old time people, yeah. I forget, did he play on the boat or not? No, no. Not on the boat, he was in the dances and stuff. No, he was playing on the boat. He used to play violin and led the band. So he did. Who would he have in his man? George McCullough, of course, and myself.
Raymond Brown. What did he play? Which one? Trombone. Trombone. He's dead now. Yeah.
